references.text: David expresses a similar thought about seeking the Lord and finding him, which reflects the idea of asking and receiving, seeking and finding.
The call to seek the Lord and his strength, and continually seek his face, resonates with the idea of persistent seeking that is rewarded.
The call to seek the Lord while he may be found, and to call on him while he is near, mirrors the idea of seeking and finding, and asking and receiving.
The Lord's promise to let himself be found by Israel when they seek him with all their heart emphasizes the importance of sincere seeking.
Luke repeats almost verbatim Jesus' words from Matthew, emphasizing the importance of asking, seeking, and knocking.
Peter quotes the prophet Joel that everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved, which resonates with the idea of asking to receive.
